product_overview: CampFix is a web-based facilities management and event coordination platform for educational institutions. It helps users report and track maintenance concerns, request and approve events, manage categories and users, and receive system notifications through a role-based workflow.
core_goals: Provide secure user authentication with JWT and web session support
Enable students and faculty to submit and track concerns and event requests
Support MIS, maintenance, and admin workflows for assignment, approval, and resolution
Deliver categorized notifications and profile management for authenticated users
Offer administrative visibility through dashboards, user management, and analytics

features.name: Authentication & User Management
features.description: Allows users to register, log in, access their account, refresh tokens, and log out using JWT-based authentication.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid name, email, and password -> Receive 201 with user created -> POST /api/auth/login with registered credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token and user data -> GET /api/auth/user with token -> Receive 200 with authenticated user object
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with invalid credentials message -> GET /api/auth/user without token -> Receive 401 unauthorized or authentication failure
POST /api/auth/refresh with valid authenticated token -> Receive 200 with new JWT token -> POST /api/auth/logout with refreshed token -> Receive 200 with success message

features.name: Concerns Management
features.description: Supports authenticated users creating, viewing, updating, and deleting maintenance concerns with optional file attachment and category association.
user_flows: POST /api/concerns with valid title, description, category_id, location, and image while authenticated -> Receive 201 with concern created -> GET /api/concerns -> Receive 200 with user's concern list -> GET /api/concerns/{id} for the created concern -> Receive 200 with concern details

POST /api/concerns with missing or invalid fields -> Receive 422 validation error -> GET /api/concerns/{id} for a non-existent concern -> Receive 404 not found -> PUT /api/concerns/{id} on a concern the user cannot edit -> Receive 403 unauthorized
DELETE /api/concerns/{id} with authenticated owner access -> Receive 200 with concern deleted -> GET /api/concerns/{id} afterward -> Receive 404 not found or inaccessible

features.name: Event Requests
features.description: Allows users to list events, create event requests, check room availability, and handle approval or rejection workflows.
user_flows: POST /api/check-room-availability with room_id, start_date, and end_date -> Receive 200 with availability status -> POST /api/events with valid title, description, start_date, end_date, and room_id -> Receive 201 with event created -> GET /api/events/{id} -> Receive 200 with event object

POST /api/events with conflicting room and time values -> Receive 409 resource conflict -> POST /api/events with missing required fields -> Receive 422 validation error -> GET /api/events/{id} for a missing event -> Receive 404 not found
POST /events/{id}/approve as an authorized approver -> Receive 200 with event approved -> POST /events/{id}/reject as an unauthorized user -> Receive 403 unauthorized

features.name: Categories Management
features.description: Enables viewing available concern categories and restricted admin operations to create or delete categories.
user_flows: GET /api/categories առանց authentication -> Receive 200 with category list -> POST /api/categories with valid name and icon as an authenticated admin -> Receive 201 with category created -> DELETE /api/categories/{id} as an authenticated admin -> Receive 200 with category deleted
POST /api/categories as an authenticated non-admin user -> Receive 403 unauthorized -> DELETE /api/categories/{id} for a restricted category as a non-admin user -> Receive 403 unauthorized

features.name: User Profile Management
features.description: Allows authenticated users to view and update their profile, change passwords, and upload a profile picture.
user_flows: GET /profile with a valid authenticated session or token -> Receive 200 with profile page -> PUT /profile with updated name and email -> Receive 200 with profile updated -> POST /profile/upload-picture with a valid image file -> Receive 200 with picture uploaded
PUT /profile/password with a wrong current_password or invalid new_password -> Receive 422 validation error -> GET /profile without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized
PUT /profile with invalid email format -> Receive 422 validation error

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Provides administrative pages for dashboard access, analytics, user management, and assigning concerns to maintenance staff.
user_flows: GET /admin with authenticated admin credentials -> Receive 200 with dashboard page -> GET /admin/analytics -> Receive 200 with analytics data -> GET /admin/users -> Receive 200 with users list -> POST /admin/users with valid name, email, and role -> Receive 201 with user created
GET /admin with a non-admin authenticated user -> Receive 403 unauthorized -> POST /admin/users with missing or invalid fields -> Receive 422 validation error or request failure
POST /concerns/{id}/assign with a valid staff_id as authorized admin -> Receive 200 with concern assigned -> POST /concerns/{id}/assign as an unauthorized user -> Receive 403 unauthorized

features.name: Notifications System
features.description: Supports notification inbox actions and unread-count retrieval for authenticated users.
user_flows: GET /api/notifications/unread-count with a valid auth token -> Receive 200 with unread count -> GET /notifications/{id}/read -> Receive 200 with notification marked as read -> DELETE /notifications/{id} -> Receive 200 with notification deleted
GET /api/notifications/unread-count without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> GET /notifications/{id}/read for a missing notification -> Receive 404 not found or failure
